import numpy as np
print(SITES)
print({k:v.shape for k,v in W.items()})
print(X.shape, X[:3])

import numpy as np
WE=W['W_E']; WP=W['W_pos']; WU=W['W_U']
M0=np.einsum('de,ef->df',W['L0.W_Q'][0],W['L0.W_K'][0].T)
M1=np.einsum('de,ef->df',W['L1.W_Q'][0],W['L1.W_K'][0].T)
V0=np.einsum('de,ef->df',W['L0.W_V'][0],W['L0.W_O'][0])
V1=np.einsum('de,ef->df',W['L1.W_V'][0],W['L1.W_O'][0])
G=V1@WU
def fwd(xx, WE,WP,M0,V0,M1,G,WU):
    B=xx.shape[0]
    R=WE[xx]+WP
    S=R@M0@R.transpose(0,2,1)/2
    A0=np.exp(S-S.max(-1,keepdims=True)); A0/=A0.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    Z=R+A0@R@V0
    qv=Z@M1
    T=np.einsum('bpd,bqd->bpq',qv,Z)/2
    A1=np.exp(T-T.max(-1,keepdims=True)); A1/=A1.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    out=Z[:,4]@WU+np.einsum('bk,bkq,qc->bc',A1[:,4],Z,G)
    return out,A0,Z,A1
out,A0,Z,A1=fwd(X,WE,WP,M0,V0,M1,G,WU)
real=run(X)
print('max diff out',np.abs(out-real).max(), 'argmax match',(out.argmax(1)==real.argmax(1)).mean())
a=acts(X[:64])
print('A0 match',np.abs(A0[:64]-a['attn0.pattern'][:,0*25:]).max())
print('Z match',np.abs(Z[:64].reshape(64,-1)-a['resid0.mid']).max())

import numpy as np
def sm(S):
    S=S-S.max(-1,keepdims=True); A=np.exp(S); return A/A.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
real=run(X); dec=real.argmax(1)
We_i=WEi; Wp_i=WPi
def build(E,P,M0,V0,M1,V1,WU):

import numpy as np
def sm(S):
    S=S-S.max(-1,keepdims=True); A=np.exp(S); return A/A.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
real=run(X); dec=real.argmax(1)
mats={}
def build2(E,P,M0,V0,M1,V1,WU):
    e=E[X]+P
    A0=sm(e@M0@e.transpose(0,2,1)/2)
    Z=e+A0@e@V0
    A1=sm(np.einsum('bpd,bqd->bpq',Z@M1,Z)/2)
    o1=np.einsum('bk,bkd->bd',A1[:,4],Z)@V1
    return (Z[:,4]+o1)@WU
def rnd(M,q): return np.round(M*q)/q
base=[WEi,WPi,M0i,V0i,M1i,V1O1,WUi]

import numpy as np
def sm(S):
    S=S-S.max(-1,keepdims=True); A=np.exp(S); return A/A.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
real=run(X); dec=real.argmax(1)
def build3(E,P,M0,V0,M1,V1,WU):
    e=E[X]+P
    A0=sm(e@M0@e.transpose(0,2,1)/2)
    Z=e+A0@e@V0
    A1=sm(np.einsum('bpd,bqd->bpq',Z@M1,Z)/2)
    o1=np.einsum('bk,bkd->bd',A1[:,4],Z)@V1
    return (Z[:,4]+o1)@WU
def rnd(M,q): return np.round(M*q)/q
def chars(M,q):
    return sum(len(str(abs(int(round(v*q))))) for v in M.ravel())
base=[WEi,WPi,M0i,V0i,M1i,V1O1,WUi]
names=['E','P','M0','V0','M1','V1','WU']

"Only position 4 is read out: out = (Z[4] + a1.(Z V1)) W_U, where a1 is row 4 of layer-1 attention and V1 = W_V1 W_O1 "
"is itself nearly rank 2, so the readout uses two value directions. All matrices below are the network's own, written as "
"integer tables divided by 1000; an attention row is stored as its first 4 weights, the fifth being 1 minus their sum, "
"so that every row of named variables is a distribution.")

V0=T("1691 938 -494 453 523 583 -140 760 -601 1063 -147 -838 459 1326 -258 1043",4,4)
M1=T("-291 -549 465 1231 -166 -341 288 505 -1556 -5278 6376 9313 -259 -770 1061 1025",4,4)
V1=T("-533 11540 -3010 -161 2118 -1621 -470 1404 -168 16038 -1941 -3937 -535 -7531 3190 -2708",4,4)

# LAB NOTES — 2-layer attention-only transformer (5 tokens, width 4, no bias, no LN, no mask)

## 1. What the network does
- Inputs: all 5^5 = 3125 sequences over tokens {0..4}. Output: 5 logits per sequence; decision = argmax.
- Class frequencies: 0 ≈ 45% (1404), 1 ≈ 38% (1177), 2 ≈ 17% (532), 3 ≈ 0.4% (12). Network is wrong on ~19% of held-out inputs relative to an unknown task rule worth 81.0% fidelity (i.e. the task rule is only 81% — the *network* is NOT a clean task rule, it is an emergent smooth scoring function).
- Not permutation invariant; no simple recognizable rule (not sum mod k, not mode/min/max/argmin/argmax/counts). Best single-feature classifiers ≈ 50%. Additive per-position linear fit to logits R² only 0.36 ⇒ the essential nonlinearity is the attention softmax (token×token products). Tendency only: increasing sequences → class 0, decreasing → class 2.

## 2. Exact mechanism (verified to 3e-13, decisions 100%)
Residual R[p] = W_E[tok_p] + W_pos[p], shape (N,5,4). Per layer l: score = x M_l xᵀ/2 with M_l = W_Ql W_Klᵀ **for layer 0** (note: for layer 1 the score is (Z M1)·Z / 2 with M1 = W_Q1 W_K1ᵀ, the same reduced form), softmax over keys (no mask), then x ← x + (A x)(W_V W_O).

**Reduced forward (this is the whole construction):**
```
e  = W_E[x] + W_pos                    # (B,5,4)   site 'embed'
S  = e M0 eᵀ / 2                       # M0 = W_Q0 W_K0ᵀ
A0 = softmax_keys(S)                   # site attn0.pattern (5×5)
o0 = A0 e V0                           # V0 = W_V0 W_O0;  site attn0.out
Z  = e + o0                            # site resid0.mid
T  = (Z M1) Zᵀ / 2                     # M1 = W_Q1 W_K1ᵀ
A1 = softmax_keys(T)                   # site attn1.pattern (only row 4 read)
a1 = A1[4]                             # row of position 4
o1 = a1 · (Z V1)                       # V1 = W_V1 W_O1 (4×4);  site attn1.out
r1 = Z[4] + o1                         # site resid1.mid
out = r1 @ W_U
```
Equivalently (with G = V1 @ W_U): out = Z[4]@W_U + Σ_k a1[k] (Z[k]@G).

**Integer tables used in the submitted file (value = entry/1000). These are the real weights rounded to 3 decimals; fidelity 99.9%, all 7 sites PASS.**
- W_E (5×4) = [[-555,-2026,1424,301],[1022,-1087,678,1846],[999,-200,1144,1396],[1769,1896,1094,-522],[-640,-17,2882,-74]]

- M0 (4×4) = [[-16742,3424,-21421,-15363],[-20575,10823,-20548,8575],[851,5740,13216,10749],[11627,-7776,5781,-4136]]
- V0 (4×4) = [[1691,938,-494,453],[523,583,-140,760],[-601,1063,-147,-838],[459,1326,-258,1043]]
- M1 (4×4) = [[-291,-549,465,1231],[-166,-341,288,505],[-1556,-5278,6376,9313],[-259,-770,1061,1025]]
- V1 = W_V1 W_O1 (4×4) = [[-533,11540,-3010,-161],[2118,-1621,-470,1404],[-168,16038,-1941,-3937],[-535,-7531,3190,-2708]]
